numbers.value: “Figure out where in the past the subject is currently living.”
numbers.label: Search manual, dementia chapter
numbers.source_name: Robert Koester, Lost Person Behavior — Dementia
numbers.quote: Figure out where in the past the subject is currently “living” in order to determine possible destinations (e.g., a former residence, a work place).

numbers.value: “List locations even if they no longer exist.”
numbers.label: Search manual questionnaire
numbers.source_name: Robert Koester, Lost Person Behavior — Dementia
numbers.quote: List all of the subject’s addresses, dwelling types, and how long he has lived at each address going back to childhood. List locations even if they no longer exist.

numbers.label: UK Herbert Protocol is named after a veteran who died looking for his childhood home
numbers.quote: It originated in Norfolk and takes its name after Normandy landings veteran George Herbert, who lived with dementia and died in 2011, after going missing whilst looking for his childhood home.

numbers.value: “Any important past addresses including childhood addresses or past jobs.”

numbers.quote: Any important past addresses including childhood addresses or past jobs.

numbers.label: recent memories are lost before older ones
numbers.quote: T. Ribot's (1881) law of retrograde amnesia states that brain damage impairs recently formed memories to a greater extent than older memories
